## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what this change does. Link related public issues.

## Verification

List relevant commands, results and skipped/unavailable checks. For interface changes include synthetic mobile/desktop evidence and keyboard checks. For documentation explain how claims and links were checked.

## Deployment and compatibility

Describe migration/configuration requirements, affected permissions, recovery considerations and known limitations, or state that none apply.

## Review checks

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation reflects the resulting behavior.
- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots are synthetic or approved public material; no patient data, credentials or private artifacts are included.
- [ ] Relevant verification is recorded, including skips.
- [ ] Third-party material has an identified source/license and required attribution.
- [ ] I am authorized to contribute this work under AGPL-3.0-only.
